tagline_or_mission.supporting_quote: Champions Counseling is here to help you unlock the change you desire in your life. Champions accepts insurances including Medicaid. Medicaid counseling.
Creating change in life is hard and we look forward to witnessing your transformation.

We are a team of experienced professionals dedicated to mental health services of every individual. Our experience enables us to offer effective outpatient and individualized counseling. We treat a number of mental health disorders and provide a neutral ground to individuals, families, and couples. Medicaid counseling and most major insurances are accepted!
We promise to be there for you at every step of your journey. Our goal is to help you grow from your struggles, heal from your pain, and move forward to where you want to be in your life.

Our focus is to help individuals heal, energize, and become aware of their inner strengths. We achieve this by providing a neutral safe space, listening to your concerns, and customizing a treatment plan.
The therapists at Champions Counseling believe it is our mission to provide effective, individualized counseling to everyone in the Colorado Springs area. And to us, everyone means everyone.

inferences.statement: Andrew “Drew” Pierce is the owner of the practice that legally operates as North Springs Counseling LLC, DBA Champions Counseling. User-supplied mailboxes drew@counselingchampions.com and northspringscounseling@gmail.com therefore belong to the same organization as the website-published Championscounseling@gmail.com, not to a second prospect.
Sarah Smith’s heading says LPCC while her bio says therapist-in-training / pursuing a master’s. Import both wordings; do not silently drop either.
The heading “Emily Sack's” may be a typo, but that is unconfirmed. Keep the website spelling in the imported name field.
Provider office labels are Dublin, Briargate, or Telehealth only. Telehealth-labeled clinicians may still be affiliated with the practice offices; the website does not say they never use an office.
